title: Retry or outbox for failed feedback alert emails
reason: A failed alert is logged and lost — no retry, no queue, no operator-facing signal. Deliberate per P13 Decision 2 (containment had to be total) and fine while feedback is durably stored, but not once someone relies on the email as their notification channel.
trigger: A real alert observed missing/failed on the box, volume growth past single-owner scale, or any work adding a second notification channel or preferences surface.
